body.name: Fixed-radius causal-isotonic model
body.construction: \(\mathcal M(d,s,L,B,\delta,c_{\theta},C_{\theta},c_p,C_p,c_g,C_g,v_{\kappa},V_{\kappa})=\{P:c_{\theta}\le C_{\theta},\ c_p\le1\le C_p,\ c_g\le1\le C_g,\ v_{\kappa}\le V_{\kappa},\ c_{\theta}/2+\sqrt{v_{\kappa}}\le B,\ L\ge L_0;\ \exists P^{\mathrm F}\text{ such that }\texttt{ass:observed-marginal},\texttt{ass:consistency},\texttt{ass:exchangeability},\texttt{ass:potential-mean-continuity}\text{ hold under }P^{\mathrm F},\text{ and }\texttt{ass:outcome-bound},\texttt{ass:p-smooth},\texttt{ass:g-smooth},\texttt{ass:m-smooth},\texttt{ass:r-smooth},\texttt{ass:p-bounds},\texttt{ass:p-normalization},\texttt{ass:overlap},\texttt{ass:g-normalization},\texttt{ass:monotone},\texttt{ass:strict-slope},\texttt{ass:variance}\text{ hold for the observed marginal }P\}\).
